headline: Mark Zuckerberg’s AI Manifesto Is 6,500 Words—and Barely Says Anything
context: AI is shifting the culture, from tech CEO manifestos to 1 am job interviews. We unpack some of the latest, along with the top findings from Black Hat and Defcon, this week on Uncanny Valley.
